name: multi-turn-v2

pii_check.method: core.reviews.payload_contains_pii over every free-text case field

documentation: RAG-006 is built. Each case carries the raw follow-up in query and the conversation it resolves in prior_turns; the runner plans a standalone retrieval query from both with tenantchat.core.planning before scoring, so recall measures the resolved query, not a hand-authored one. vocabulary is the tenant's server-approved known terms the planner may carry out of history. Scenarios cover pronouns and ellipsis, corrections, topic shifts, and malicious prior turns; a hostile prior turn must never contribute words to the resolved query.
